overview: Deviants are sentient creatures/objects mutated by Stardust that players can capture and bond with as companions. Each Deviant falls into one of three main purposes — Combat, Territory (utility/gathering), or Crafting (produces materials) — and grants passive or active abilities. Once Human's catalog includes 80+ Deviations (per oncehumandb.com); this database covers 65, including the 4 added by the 'Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve' scenario (Whalepup, Soul Summoner, Director Fox — Zapamander is already listed under Bosses/event content) and the 3 time-limited Palworld-collaboration companions; the '(Way of Winter)' tag notes ones introduced in that seasonal update and (PvP)/(PvE) note mode-specific abilities.

captureMethod.wildCapture: Spot a Deviant as a floating orb containing the creature in the world; interact (F) to attempt capture. Each failed attempt raises your success chance, but the Deviant escapes after 3 failed tries.
captureMethod.bindingCapsule: Alternatively, craft a Binding Capsule to capture a Deviant more reliably (previously unlocked via the old Memetics menu under Logistics; this recipe now lives somewhere in the current Tech Tree / crafting menus — this database has not independently re-verified its exact current location).
captureMethod.placement: A captured Deviant only provides its ability once placed in an Isolated Securement Unit at your territory — build multiple units to run several Deviants at once.
captureMethod.power: Each Deviant has a Deviant Power meter that depletes as it works; once empty it goes inactive until it recharges (time, or resources/feed depending on the Deviant).
captureMethod.cookingLink: Securement Soup and Stardust Italian Soup Can (see the Food & Cooking section) both grant +1 Deviation capture ability level, making wild captures easier while active.
